*   **🔥 DATABASE UPDATED! 🔥**
*   Bhai, aapki 130+ words ki massive list 100% feed ho chuki hai!
*   Aapne "Extreme Repetition" manga hai, wahi milega. Har word itni baar samne aayega ki dimaag usko chah kar bhi bhool nahi payega.
*   Kyunki words bahut saare hain, System V3.1 isko **Adaptive Chunks** me todega taaki **Brain Load** na ho aur 100% memory retention rahe.

==================================================
*   **🔥 DAILY TARGET DASHBOARD (DAY 3 - CHUNK 1) 🔥**
*   **Theme:** Bitterness, Hard Work & Relief (कड़वाहट, कड़ी मेहनत और राहत) 🛠️
*   **Today's Target:** User List First 10 Words + 5 Idioms + 5 Phrasal Verbs.
*   **Format:** 100% Bullet Points. Zero Paragraphs.
==================================================

*   **🎬 MULTI-SENSORY SCENE**
*   *Color:* गहरा लाल (गस्सा) और हल्का नीला (राहत).
*   *Sound:* भारी हथौड़े चलने की आवाज़ और फिर एक गहरी चैन की सांस.
*   *Emotion:* बहुत थकने के बाद अचानक से दर्द कम होने की फीलिंग.

==================================================
*   **🤬 GROUP 1: THE HARSH FAMILY (कड़वे और आक्रामक)**

*   **1. ACERBIC (Uh-sur-bik)**
*   **Meaning:** Harsh or bitter in speaking (कड़वा या तीखा स्वभाव).
*   **Multi-Sensory:** *Taste:* नींबू या एसिड जैसा खट्टा-कड़वा टेस्ट.
*   **Desi Trick:** ACID + BIK. "Acid बिक" रहा है! जो इंसान एसिड पी लेगा, उसकी आवाज़ *acerbic* (कड़वी) हो जाएगी.
*   **Cross-Link:** Ye इंसान हमेशा दूसरों को **Excoriate** (धज्जियां उड़ाना) करता है.
*   **Sentence:** The critic wrote an acerbic review of the new movie.

*   **2. AVERSION (Uh-vur-zhun)** [Source: User List / PDF 5]
*   **Meaning:** A strong dislike or disinclination (सख्त नफरत).
*   **Desi Trick:** A + VERSION. मुझे इस App का पुराना 'Version' बिल्कुल पसंद नहीं है, मुझे इससे *aversion* है.
*   **Sentence:** He has a deep aversion to eating green vegetables.

*   **3. AGGRESSIVELY (Uh-gres-iv-lee)**
*   **Meaning:** In a forceful, determined, or hostile manner (आक्रामक रूप से).
*   **Desi Trick:** AGREE + GUSA. किसी को गुस्से से डरा कर अपनी बात पर 'Agree' करवाना.
*   **Sentence:** The company aggressively marketed its new product.

==================================================
*   **😌 GROUP 2: THE RELIEF & CHANGE FAMILY (बदलाव और राहत)**

*   **4. ALLEVIATE (Uh-lee-vee-ayt)** [Source: PDF 5, User List]
*   **Meaning:** To make pain or a problem less severe (दर्द या परेशानी कम करना).
*   **Desi Trick:** ALL + EVIL + ATE. अगर दुनिया के सारे 'Evil' (बुराई) को कोई 'Ate' (खा ले), तो दुनिया का दर्द *alleviate* हो जाएगा.
*   **Cross-Link:** Ye **Assuage** और **Mitigate** का जुड़वा भाई है.
*   **Sentence:** The doctor gave her an injection to alleviate the pain.

*   **5. ALTERED (Awl-terd)**
*   **Meaning:** Changed in character or composition (बदला हुआ).
*   **Desi Trick:** ALTER (दर्जी/Tailor). दर्जी जैसे कपड़े की फिटिंग 'Alter' (बदल) देता है.
*   **Sentence:** The city's skyline has altered significantly over the years.

*   **6. AUGMENTED (Awg-men-ted)** [Source: User List]
*   **Meaning:** Having been made greater in size or value (बढ़ाया हुआ).
*   **Desi Trick:** AUG (August) + MINT. अगस्त के महीने में मिंट (पुदीना) की डिमांड *augment* (बढ़) जाती है.
*   **Sentence:** He augmented his income by working a part-time job.

==================================================
*   **🛠️ GROUP 3: HARD WORK & SKILL (मेहनत और कौशल)**

*   **7. ARDUOUS (Ar-joo-us)** [Source: User List, PDF 5]
*   **Meaning:** Involving a lot of effort and energy; difficult and tiring (कठिन और थकाऊ).
*   **Desi Trick:** HARD + DO + US. ये काम 'Hard' है 'Do' (करने) में हमारे (Us) लिए = *Arduous*.
*   **Cross-Link:** Ye काम इंसान को **Lethargic** (थका हुआ) बना देता है.
*   **Sentence:** Climbing Mount Everest is an arduous journey.

*   **8. APPRENTICESHIP (Uh-pren-tis-ship)**
*   **Meaning:** A period of time working for a skilled person to learn a trade (प्रशिक्षुता / काम सीखना).
*   **Desi Trick:** APPRENTICE (Trainee).
*   **Sentence:** He served an apprenticeship as a carpenter.

*   **9. ARTICULATING (Ar-tik-yuh-lay-ting)** [Source: PDF 6, User List]
*   **Meaning:** Expressing ideas clearly and effectively (स्पष्ट रूप से व्यक्त करना).
*   **Desi Trick:** ART + CALCULATE. जो इंसान अपनी बात को 'Calculate' करके एक 'Art' की तरह बोले.
*   **Sentence:** She is great at articulating her thoughts during meetings.

*   **10. ASYMMETRY (A-sim-i-tree)**
*   **Meaning:** Lack of equality or equivalence between parts (असमानता / बेमेल).
*   **Desi Trick:** A (Not) + SYMMETRY (समानता). जहाँ दोनों साइड बराबर ना हों.
*   **Sentence:** There is a growing asymmetry in wealth distribution.

==================================================
*   **🎭 5 IDIOMS (THEME: GOOD vs BAD SITUATIONS)** [Source: PDF 2, 6]

*   **11. Cream of the crop**
*   **Meaning:** The best of a group (सबमें सर्वश्रेष्ठ).
*   **Trick:** दूध के ऊपर की मलाई (Cream) सबसे बेस्ट होती है.
*   **Sentence:** Only the cream of the crop get selected for this job.

*   **12. Out of the frying pan into the fire**
*   **Meaning:** From one bad situation to a worse one (आसमान से गिरे खजूर में अटके).
*   **Sentence:** Quitting his job without a backup plan was like jumping out of the frying pan into the fire.

*   **13. Over a barrel**
*   **Meaning:** In a helpless position (मज़बूरी की हालत में होना).
*   **Trick:** किसी को बैरल (ड्रम) के ऊपर उल्टा लटका देना, वो हिल भी नहीं पाएगा.
*   **Sentence:** The supplier has us over a barrel because they are the only ones who make this part.

*   **14. Cry over spilt milk**
*   **Meaning:** Regret something irreversible (जो हो गया उस पर पछताना).
*   **Sentence:** You failed the exam, but don't cry over spilt milk. Start studying again.

*   **15. Cup of tea**
*   **Meaning:** A favorite activity or something one is good at (पसंदीदा काम).
*   **Sentence:** Solving complex puzzles is not my cup of tea.

==================================================
*   **⚙️ 5 PHRASAL VERBS (THEME: BUSINESS & ACTION)** [Source: PDF 5]

*   **16. Scaling up**
*   **Meaning:** To make something larger in size or amount (पैमाना बढ़ाना).
*   **Sentence:** The startup is scaling up its operations across the country.

*   **17. Map out**
*   **Meaning:** To decide in detail how something will be done (पूरी प्लानिंग करना).
*   **Sentence:** We need to map out a clear strategy for the next year.

*   **18. Hush up**
*   **Meaning:** To keep something a secret / stop a rumor (बात दबाना या छुपाना).
*   **Sentence:** The company tried to hush up the financial scandal.

*   **19. Roll out**
*   **Meaning:** To offer a new product or service to the public (लॉन्च करना).
*   **Sentence:** Apple will roll out its new software next week.

*   **20. Draw flak**
*   **Meaning:** To receive strong criticism (कड़ी आलोचना झेलना).
*   **Cross-Link:** Jab koi **Excoriate** karta hai, tab aap flak draw karte ho.
*   **Sentence:** The politician drew flak for his controversial comments.

==================================================
